suite: r1102 compact ambience cards and native information controls
limitations: Four isolated Classic/Feyz Chromium profiles at 320×740 and390×844 in Turkish and English; both canonical Esma and Berhetiyye themes. Physical Android touch and audible-output quality are not tested.

All card geometry is measured. A trusted information click per rendered group, native close/Escape, one channel switch and native keyboard volume edit verify handlers. No dhikr, speech, recording, microphone or broad audio suite is started.

The custom-sounds empty state is checked before adding one explicitly labelled custom catalogue row in disposable memory only. Its edit/delete controls are measured; it has no recording and is never played.
Service workers and external requests are blocked by the shared fixture. Screenshots are local visual QA evidence only.
